MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Fish culture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Fish culture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Fish culture.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Fish culture.

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Record keeping in aquaculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Record keeping in aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Record keeping in aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and climatic conditions in marine and Freshwater and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fishery by-products and their industrial uses 4.0 Marine Operations and Blue Eco and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fishery by- products and their industrial uses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. C — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

2. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

3. A — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

4. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.

5. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

6. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.

7. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.

8. A — Glucose and oxygen

9. D — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

10. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

11. A — newton (N)

12. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
